Set creates or updates a state entry for an agent spawned on this host.

A coordinator that wasn't spawned with "agent spawn" has no agent record, so
it can't have state: have it pass results through a helper's state or
messages instead.

Usage:
  agent state set <name> <key> <value> [flags]

Examples:
  agent state set researcher status working
  agent state set researcher progress "50%"

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for set

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
